author: Donkles55
quote:
I do have to admit that I do like certain aspects of the game however the negativity of actually playing it outweighs it.  Perhaps in time this opinion will change which I hope.

It's just too politically motivated rather than feeling like an actual GTA.  Combat doesn't feel fun and there is a certain aspect of it that makes you feel worse.  The freedom of the world is compromised with a larger police presence which feels limiting.

Otherwise I absolutely hate Lucia and wish there was an option to cut her out of the story completely.  Her character feels like a stereotypical wife which I would argue isn't the female empowerment they are going for.  Rather I feel she could have opened a ton of doors if her character wasn't the way she is.

We need to stop woke and actually write realistic characters.
